name: Project Management
description: An open source Project management tool based on Laravel and Filament

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Db password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-project-management application
services:
  # The `big-bear-project-management` service definition
  big-bear-project-management:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-project-management
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: eloufirhatim/helper:1.2.3@sha256:200b25415273529ca5c6513b5ce99931e46bee17e2c730c4d3c2cbc53992fd2e
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables
    environment:
      - DB_CONNECTION=mysql
      - DB_HOST=big-bear-project-management-db
      - DB_PORT=3306
      - DB_DATABASE=project_management
      - DB_USERNAME=project_management
      - DB_PASSWORD=${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
      - MAIL_MAILER=smtp
      - MAIL_HOST=mailpit
      - MAIL_PORT=1025
      - MAIL_USERNAME=
      - MAIL_PASSWORD=
      - MAIL_ENCRYPTION=null
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 8000 of the host to port 8000 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:8000"
    networks:
      - big_bear_project_management_network
    depends_on:
      - big-bear-project-management-db
  big-bear-project-management-db:
    image: mysql:5.7@sha256:4bc6bc963e6d8443453676cae56536f4b8156d78bae03c0145cbe47c2aad73bb
    container_name: big-bear-project-management-db
    environment:
      - MYSQL_DATABASE=project_management
      - MYSQL_USER=project_management
      - MYSQL_PASSWORD=${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
      - MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - big_bear_project_management_network
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping", "-h", "localhost", "-p${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}"]
      interval: 20s
      start_period: 10s
      timeout: 10s
networks:
  big_bear_project_management_network:
    driver: bridge
